main_text.l: in Ecclesiâ celebrata; & ex hâc suaui redemptionis nostræ commemoratione, aliud e-mergit sacrificium, θυσία αἰνέσεως; & ex illo denique, pacificum: Tria ergo cùm hîc se offerant sacrificia; propitiatorium certè, nisi forte (vt Glossa interpretatur) repræsentatiuè, nullum est, nullum essentiale, nullum (quod Tridentini contendunt) verum, ac proprium; imo nec esse potest: Quid enim? Idemne offert Sacerdos quod Christus obtulit an aliud? Si aliud, non ergo propitiatorium, solus enim Christus ἱλασμός: sin idem, tum non ἀναίμακτον; cruentum enim erat Christi

page.notes: The Greek words (θυσία αἰνέσεως, ἱλασμός, ἀναίμακτον) are reproduced from the scan and may contain small errors. The marginal note "Trid.Sess.22." stands right of the text. Faint show-through from the reverse side appears in the margins and was omitted. The catchword "Christi" is printed at the foot right.
